name: Lycaonia
overview: Lycaonia was a province in Asia Minor where Paul and his companions preached the gospel, notably in the cities of Lystra and Derbe. In Acts 14, we see Paul healing a man crippled from birth, which led the local people to mistakenly believe that Paul and Barnabas were gods in human form. This account highlights the power of God working through Paul to confirm the message of salvation and the challenge of directing people’s faith toward the one true God rather than human idols.
